title: Crestwave partnership outreach — raw jot
content:
Topline: Crestwave (mid-market retail POS + loyalty) looks like a good pilot candidate for server-side embeddings + chat agent for store ops. Quick notes from research call + surface-level account research.

Account snapshot
- Company: Crestwave Retail Systems (HQ: Denver) — ~750 stores, B2B SaaS to convenience & grocery chains.
- ARR: estimated $45M. Recent Series D (2024) per press.
- Tech: mostly microservices on GCP; owns a lightweight edge server running on customer-prem terminals.
- Pain: ops inefficiency for in-store staff (lookup returns, shift handoffs), high ticket deflection needed.
- Decision makers: Head of Product (Marta Ruiz), VP Ops (Tom Gleason), Dir Eng (Rohit Menon). Champion possible: Marta (meeting intro via Evan M).

Why Redwood fits (quick hooks)
- Low-latency local inference for POS terminals (Private deployment / VPC) — keeps PII in-network, meets compliance asks.
- Cost-aware controls (dedicated capacity + quantized models) — good for high-per-store scale and predictable invoices.
- Console + rollouts — ops team can A/B chat assistant updates across customer cohorts.

Outbound sequence ideas (short multi-channel):
1) Email #1 (intro + data point) — Subject: "Reduce store ticket times by 25% — pilot idea". Body: quick stat, ask for 20-min intro with Marta/Tom.
2) LinkedIn connect + one-liner referencing Marta's talk on retail ops.
3) Email #2 (2 days later) — one-pager attached: pilot scope + success metrics + high-level cost estimate.
4) Call attempt + voicemails.
5) Short demo invite with sample transcript from a mock store agent.

Personalized subject line options (A/B test):
- "Pilot: in-store assistant for cashiers (no new hardware)"
- "How Crestwave could cut in-store training time by half"
- "Quick pilot to reduce lost-sale events on checkout lanes"

Call prep bullets (for intro with Marta)
- 10–12 min discovery, 15 min of questions.
- Ask: what metrics do you use for store efficiency? current ticket volumes? average handle time for floor ops?
- Surface technical: what terminals OS/version; do they allow local containers; any firewall/VPN constraints?
- Pilot ask: 30 stores, 6-week pilot, 2-week integration window, success metrics: 20%+ ticket deflection OR 30s reduction in AHT.

Objection handling (common ones we've seen)
- "We can't host external models on our terminals" -> Response: private deployment option + air-gapped pack for on-prem; KMS integrations for keys; propose PoC on a small subset of dedicated test terminals.
- "Cost concerns at scale" -> Response: show dedicated vs hosted TCO model: batching + quantization can drop per-token cost ~3–5x; provide monthly projection for 750 stores at expected query rate.
- "Quality/regression risk" -> Response: Redwood Optimize + eval hooks + canary rollouts to compare responses to baseline; propose backup fallthrough to remote hosted model if local variant fails.
- "Data security / compliance" -> Response: VPC/private control plane, audit logs, HSM/KMS options, we can sign an early NDA.

Pilot skeleton (one-pager outline)
- Goal: reduce in-store ops ticket time and improve first-call resolution for store staff.
- Scope: 30 pilot stores (mix urban/suburban), packaged private deployment running lightweight model for retrieval-augmented chat, sync to central knowledge base.
- Success metrics: ticket deflection %, avg handle time, CSAT from staff.
- Timeline: week 0 sign -> week 1 onboarding -> week 3 infra + model tuning -> week 4 live pilot -> week 10 wrap + review.
- Rough cost: engineering integration + infra estimate (ballpark) — we will craft more after discovery.

Sample outbound draft (email #1)
Hi Marta —
I enjoyed your panel at RetailNext last month — great points on frontline training. At Redwood Inference we help retail platforms cut in-store ticket times by running private, low-latency language models that sit near POS terminals (no cloud transit).
Would you be open to a quick 20-min conversation to discuss a lightweight pilot for 30 stores? I can share a one-page scope and estimated cost.
Best,
Aisha

Open questions / risks to verify
- Can Crestwave install local containers on existing terminals? If not, can we use a regional edge gateway?
- Are there contractual constraints with existing customers that prevent in-device code?
- Who owns the integration work on their side (partner success vs platform eng)?

Next steps (to-do)
- Evan to intro to Marta via warm note (target: next Tue).
- Draft 1-pager (owner: Aisha) with pilot scope + projected TCO by Fri 2026-02-20.
- Prepare a 3-slide demo with sample convo and latency/cost numbers (owner: Samira).
- Prep security FAQ doc and NDA stub (owner: Growth-legal).

Notes to self (stream-of-consciousness):
- If they push back on terminal install, pitch gateway hybrid: terminals -> edge gateway in store -> private cluster. Could be lower lift.
- Pull recent retail case studies (Oxbow pilot numbers).
- Keep outreach concise — Marta gets ~100 emails/day. Lean on a single KPI in subject line.

End of jot.
